records.title: Advances and Challenges in Semantic Textual Similarity: A Comprehensive Survey
records.reason: This survey reviews semantic-textual-similarity tasks and methods; it does not present a concrete Transformer/LLM inference efficiency method despite its broad BERT lineage.

records.title: CPMamba: Selective State Space Models for MIMO Channel Prediction in High-Mobility Environments
records.reason: CPMamba predicts MIMO wireless channels; it is a communications forecasting model, not language modeling or LLM inference.

records.title: MetaTPT: Meta Test-time Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models
records.reason: MetaTPT adapts vision-language prompts at test time through a meta-learned auxiliary task; the paper evaluates adaptation/robustness, not inference-cost reduction. It is related to test-time adaptation but the extra optimization may increase inference cost.

records.title: EdgeCNN-TrafficNet v2: Clip-Wise Spatio - Temporal Fusion and On-Device Adaptation for Energy-Efficient Real-Time Traffic Congestion Detection
records.reason: EdgeCNN-TrafficNet v2 is an edge CNN for traffic congestion detection with on-device adaptation/compression; it is a non-language vision task and has no transferable LLM inference mechanism established.

records.title: Tensor-Compressed and Fully-Quantized Training of Neural PDE Solvers
records.reason: The paper quantizes/tensor-compresses training of neural PDE solvers; it is scientific-computing model training, not LLM inference/deployment.
